paragraphs: From Limerick, Castlemungret, depart left onto the N69 and continue for just under 1km
Take the next left onto an unnamed road turn left again onto Mungret Road
Follow Mungret Road as it takes you toward the local estates for your first bit of steady driving
Continue along Mungret Road until you reach Quinn's Cross Roundabout
Take the roundabout, exiting left onto the unnamed road
Turn left onto Church Road take the next left into Hollymount and Ashmount estate
Work your way through Hollymount, practicing your observations and a turnabout (U-turn) manoeuvre on the quiet residential stretch before heading back out the way you came in
Retrace through Hollymount and Ashmount back onto Church Road, then at the end of the road turn left onto the R526
Take the next right onto Avonmore Road turn left onto Sullane Crescent, which becomes Norbiton Hill and then Maigue Avenue
This is a good area to practice estate driving and steady speed control
Continue straight as the road becomes Raheen Gardens, then at the end of the road turn right, staying on Raheen Gardens
Turn left onto Owenmore Drive right onto Mulcair Road
At the end of the road turn left onto Ballycummin Avenue
Take the next left onto an unnamed road and left again into Bell View, where you'll practice another turnabout before rejoining Ballycummin Avenue
Follow Ballycummin Avenue as it becomes Ballycummin Road, then at the end of the road turn left onto Saint Nessan's Road
Go straight through the next roundabout take Raheen Roundabout, exiting slight left
Continue through Quinn's Cross Roundabout (slight left exit) and on through Temple Mungret Roundabout (slight left exit), keeping a good scan on the multiple roundabouts
At the Dock Road West Roundabout take the slight left exit
Turn left and right onto the N69 briefly to practice a change of direction
Rejoin the N69 with a sharp left and follow it for around 1.5km back toward the centre
Turn left onto the unnamed road take the roundabout exiting left onto Caher Road
Turn left again on Caher Road and take the next right to arrive back at the Limerick, Castlemungret test centre
